<user_query>
You are auditing potential context/performance overhead in this repository for future Cursor agent chats. Do a medium-thorough readonly exploration and return:
1) likely high-cost prompt/context contributors (large always-applied rules, oversized markdown/docs, noisy logs, broad instructions),
2) concrete file paths and why each likely impacts latency/usage,
3) low-risk optimization ideas that preserve behavior.
Focus on AXEL project and .cursor config areas. Keep findings concise and ranked by impact.
</user_query>

Auditing `.cursor` and AXEL for large rules, docs, and noisy artifacts that inflate agent context.

[REDACTED]

Here is a **medium-thorough read-only audit** focused on AXEL and `.cursor`. Impact is ranked highest-first.

---

## 1) Likely high-cost contributors

### Tier A — catastrophic if indexed or opened
| Contributor | Why it hurts |
|-------------|----------------|
| **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\logs\debug\*.log`** | Repo scans showed extreme line counts (one file ~802k lines, another ~306k). Opening or `@`-mentioning these can dominate context and latency; accidental semantic hits would be worst-case. |
| **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\exports\moon_princess_files\`** (`moonprincess100_mobile.bundle.js`, `ContainerLauncher_bundle.js`, `main.js`, `browser.js`, etc.) | Grep reports **1–3 lines per file** because bundles are effectively **single-line minified blobs**. Character/token volume per line can still be enormous—dangerous if opened or indexed broadly (your governance already treats this as reference-only). |

### Tier B — every-chat system overhead (fixed recurring tokens / behavioral verbosity)
| Contributor | Why it hurts |
|-------------|----------------|
| **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursor\rules\axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc`** (`alwaysApply: true`) | **Always injected.** Dense checklist spanning canon hierarchy, changelog edits, QA command matrices, scene-agent invariants, **premium planning depth**, conflict gates, plus **mandatory live progress-feed formatting**. Anchors many heavy docs regardless of task relevance. |
| **Governance ↔ duplicated playbook text** | The workspace injection mirrors this rule closely (effectively **double exposition** in environments where both rule payload and mirrored descriptions appear). |

### Tier C — large Markdown surfaces (high hit probability when agents follow rules / QA skill)
| Path | Rough scale | Why it hurts |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\core\AI_CHANGELOG.md` | ~872–1000+ nonempty lines read-side | Append-only **growing file**; high accidental `@`/semantic retrieval surface once referenced by governance (changelog mandate). |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\scenes\AXEL_SCENES_NEW.md` | Hundreds of lines (glob-derived counts ~593+) | Scene encyclopedia-style volume when `@`/opened (your IDE showed ~999 lines in another snapshot → volatile growth). |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\combat\AXEL_combat_implementation.md` | ~400+ lines | Dense subsystem doc pulled frequently with combat work. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\scenes\AXEL_SCENES_BLUEPRINT.md` | ~360+ lines | Same category as scenes epic docs. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\exports\GODOT_IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md` | ~370+ lines | Export-side guidance—large when export tasks pull it in. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\exports\README.md` | ~230+ lines | Same bucket. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\references\AXEL_notes.md` | ~220+ lines | Lore/reference bulk. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\combat\AXEL_COMBAT_ITEM_CATALOG_PLAN.md` | ~210+ lines | Item roster detail when combat/items active. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\qa\AXEL_QA_REVIEW_RUBRIC.md` | ~190+ lines | Pulled on QA (`qa` skill + governance cross-reference). |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\core\AI_DOCS.md` | ~160 lines | Mandatory “read before implement” per governance—recurring read contract. |

### Tier D — fragmentation / duplication noise (latency via wrong paths + repeated searches)
| Issue | Why it hurts |
|-------|----------------|
| **`plans/` subtree mirrors** (`plans\core\`, `plans\qa\`, `plans\combat\`, `plans\scenes\`, `plans\references\`) **and** legacy-looking duplicates under `plans\` root (glob lists **both** `AXEL_SCENES_NEW.md` under root and under `scenes\`, etc.) | Agents follow rules literally → multiple candidate paths → extra searches, wrong-version reads, **double maintenance**. Governance still cites **`AXEL/axel_project/plans/AI_DOCS.md`** while readable canonical file observed under **`plans\core\AI_DOCS.md`**—path drift encourages retries and confusion. |
| **`AXEL\axel_project\plans\qa\AXEL_QA_RUN_LOG.md`** vs references elsewhere to `plans\AXEL_QA_RUN_LOG.md` | Same pattern: append-heavy log + multiple naming conventions → search churn. |

### Tier E — on-demand but non-trivial
| Path | Notes |
|------|--------|
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursor\skills\axel-simulated-qa\SKILL.md` | ~112 lines when QA runs; duplicates some governance QA detail (overlap increases effective “policy surface”). |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursor\hooks.json` | Empty `{}` hooks—negligible today. |

### Behavioral “cost” (tokens per reply, not repo bytes)
- **`axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc`** items **7–8** (live progress feed + structured bullets) tend to **inflate assistant output** on substantive AXEL work → higher conversation latency/cost even when codebase reads are small.

---

## 2) Concrete paths + impact summary (quick reference)

1. `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\logs\debug\debug-1d1bdd.log` — extreme size → avoid indexing/opening.  
2. `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\logs\debug\debug-c9d495.log` — same class.  
3. `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\exports\moon_princess_files\moonprincess100_mobile.bundle.js` (and sibling bundles) — minified megapixel-style payloads per logical line.  
4. `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursor\rules\axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc` — always-on, broad mandates.  
5. `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\core\AI_CHANGELOG.md` — large, growing.  
6. `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\scenes\AXEL_SCENES_NEW.md` — very large narrative/layout surface.  
7. `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\combat\AXEL_combat_implementation.md` — large combat spec.  
8. `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\scenes\AXEL_SCENES_BLUEPRINT.md` — large scene blueprint.  
9. `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\exports\GODOT_IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md` — large export guide.  
10. `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\qa\AXEL_QA_REVIEW_RUBRIC.md` + `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursor\skills\axel-simulated-qa\SKILL.md` — QA policy stack (overlap).  
11. **`plans/` path schizophrenia** (duplicate globs + governance pointing at `plans\AI_DOCS.md` vs working copy under `plans\core\`) — indirect latency via retries.

---

## 3) Low-risk optimization ideas (preserve behavior)

1. **Add `.cursorignore`** (or Cursor-equivalent ignore for indexing) for `logs/**`, `**/exports/moon_princess_files/**`, optional `**/*.log`, Godot `.godot/` — keeps reference assets **on disk** but **out of default retrieval**.  
2. **Normalize canonical paths in governance** so every pointer resolves to one directory (`plans/core/` vs `plans/qa/` etc.); **stub files** at legacy paths that are only 5-line “canonical path is X” redirects reduce agent thrash without deleting history.  
3. **Split `AI_CHANGELOG.md`** into rolling tail + archived yearly/quarterly files; governance says “append” only—behavior unchanged if agents only open “recent” slice by convention or stub index at top (“last N entries here”).  
4. **Slim always-on rule**: keep invariants + hierarchy + pointers; move QA command matrices / persistence footer detail **only** into `SKILL.md` with governance saying “for `qa`, follow skill”—same outcomes when QA runs, lighter default chats.  
5. **Reduce overlap** between governance §QA and `SKILL.md` (single source of truth for command lists).  
6. **Relax progress-feed prescription** to “short status unless multi-step” or cap bullets—same transparency intent, fewer output tokens.  
7. **QA run log**: keep full machine payloads in a compact `.jsonl` if needed for tooling; leave human-readable **summary** in `.md`—preserves analytics pipeline while shrinking Markdown greppability of giant JSON blocks.

---

**Net:** The dominant risks are **multi-hundred-thousand-line logs**, **minified export bundles**, and the **always-applied governance rule** (breadth + mandated verbose progress). The dominant *structural* drag is **duplicate `plans/` layouts and conflicting canonical paths**, which increases search/read churn without adding content.

*(Ask mode: no repo edits were made; `updateCurrentStep` failed in this environment due to tool JSON validation—findings above are the deliverable.)*
